params.name: lede
params.default: Give every screen of your project the help its readers need: a manual, a video, a recording or any page. Here is how to find the gaps, attach links and read them from your own app.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: steps

default.title: Coverage at a glance
default.say: This line counts the screens already documented and the live links your readers can reach. With no project yet, Register a project opens Setup, where its screens are scanned.

default.title: Find a screen
default.say: Every screen of the project is listed on the left, grouped as in Setup. Type in the Find a screen box to narrow the list by name, key or route.

default.title: Only the gaps
default.say: Tick only screens with nothing attached to see exactly which screens still need help. The number beside each screen is its count of live links.

default.title: Pick a screen
default.say: Choose a screen to edit its links on the right. With unsaved changes, you are asked before switching, so no work is lost by accident.

default.title: Add a link
default.say: Press Add a link, write what the reader sees, and paste the address. A manual section, a YouTube walkthrough, a recording or any page will do.

default.title: The kind of link
default.say: Leave the type on auto and it is read from the address: YouTube, Instagram, video, document or link. The icon beside it shows what your readers will get.

default.title: Live or retired
default.say: Unticking Live keeps a link here but hides it from readers. It is the way to retire a video without losing its address.

default.title: Links from a manual
default.say: A row marked Published by a manual was placed here by User manuals. Publishing that manual again rewrites it, so make the change in the manual itself.

default.title: Save links
default.say: Press Save links to put the changes live on this screen at once. Adding and editing links is free.

default.title: Reading these links from your app
default.say: Your own application reads these links with one request: no login, any origin, any framework. Show them behind a How to Use button on each screen.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
